description: Bonded trust layer for AI agents on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31.2). initialize, register_agent, create_bond, add_constraint, update_trust_score, execute_slash and compensate_victim were verified: 30_000_000 lamports were slashed from an agent bond into the vault and 20_000_000 paid to a victim.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of thesithunyein/equxi. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/equxi. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/equxi/
QA: devnet proof of slash and compensation
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)
